name: If I Was A Worm
summary:
In this game you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the world of dirt you call home.

Sometimes this will involve recruiting some friends by... cutting yourself in half. Other times it might require carefully shepherding a delicate egg across dangerous terrain. You may even find time to have a break and solve a jigsaw puzzle. The possibilities are truly endless.
